_comment: Source-of-truth content for the audience profile pages. Edited by hand today; designed to be written by the KoyaOS consulting loop later. build-profiles.py renders one static page per entry. The root general page is hand-maintained separately (see PROFILES.md).

_schema.accent: primary brand hex, used for buttons, links, card borders, focus
_schema.work_cards: ordered list of {title, sub, body} achievement cards
_schema.open_cards: ids of shared role cards lifted from index.html (0-6)
_schema.achievements: master board: {title, blurb, audiences[], metric?, link?} rendered at /achievements/. link makes the title open an external URL.

achievements.title: Ramara Hub — live civic information platform, built AI-native
achievements.blurb: Built and shipped a neutral, source-backed civic information hub for the Township of Ramara, Ontario, live in production at ramarahub.ca. Residents ask questions in plain language and get answers that never guess, each linked to an official source, alongside researched issue briefs, a searchable archive of public township documents, and council and budget references. Stood up solo in a weekend through AI-assisted, agent-driven content and code workflows on a static GitHub Pages front end with a Supabase backend, with resident data tools like a budget viewer and project tracker in development.
achievements.metric: live at ramarahub.ca · built in a weekend · 74 sourced answers · 7 issue briefs

achievements.title: GroomBook — live production SaaS, re-platformed with zero downtime
achievements.blurb: Rebuilt a revenue-bearing grooming platform onto Next.js and Supabase and cut the live business over with no data loss, via a reversible, gated runbook. Then shipped an in-app AI assistant the owner runs by voice and text, where every booking, payment, or message is confirmed before it saves, and deployed a full visual redesign across every screen, all to her live production app, behind the same gated pipeline. Directed an AI agent dev team (Claude + Codex) under human-gated releases, with a CI quality gate, cross-tenant isolation tests, row-level-security hardening, and error monitoring.
achievements.metric: 0 rows lost · 1,754-test CI gate · 137 clients, 737 appts live · voice AI assistant + full redesign shipped to production

achievements.title: Auction Advisor — real-time auction-intelligence platform
achievements.blurb: Conceived and architected a platform that grounds a live auction catalog of more than 22,000 items against retail prices to score deal quality, with real-time finals and full bid-trail capture. Built solo through AI-assisted engineering; diagnosed and recovered a production data-loss incident and re-established a durable system of record.
achievements.metric: 22,000+ items · high-confidence comps on more than half · in daily use

achievements.title: ChildCareOS — AI-native operations SaaS for childcare
achievements.blurb: Building an operations platform for licensed childcare centres: a funding console, attendance reconciliation, enrollment forecasting, and provincial compliance workflows. Scaffolded on Next.js and Supabase with a design partner engaged, directed end to end through an AI agent dev team under human-gated releases.
achievements.metric: design partner engaged · multi-module platform in active build

achievements.title: Agtech AR scouting — heads-up pest management for greenhouses
achievements.blurb: Designing and building an augmented-reality platform for greenhouse integrated pest management: a perception layer that turns what an agronomist sees into pest and task alerts, plus an action dispatcher that routes the work. In active build with a design partner and a live backend.
achievements.metric: design partner engaged · live backend · 53 passing tests

achievements.title: Signal Engine — video intelligence in one paste
achievements.blurb: A tool that turns any video link into a clean transcript, a summary, and purpose-specific insight. Phase 0 MVP in active build with a passing test suite; freemium model planned.

achievements.title: F1 Fantasy Optimizer — live seasonal product
achievements.blurb: A Formula 1 fantasy-league optimizer that started as a tool for friends and shipped to production, pulling the season's data to recommend the highest-value lineup each race weekend.

achievements.title: Corbel — AI-native RevOps consulting
achievements.blurb: A services-first consulting practice that reviews and rebuilds revenue-operations systems in Airtable and Notion, in Fix, Review, and Operate tiers. Full go-to-market built and readied for market: positioning, offer, pricing model, and pipeline.

achievements.title: Life Archive — reclaim your digital life
achievements.blurb: A privacy-first platform that recovers and organizes a lifetime of scattered digital history into something searchable and meaningful. Started as tooling for my own archive and now being built toward a product, including a Conversation Mirror that indexes personal message history for recall.

achievements.title: KoyaOS — multi-venture operating system
achievements.blurb: Information architecture and build of my own multi-venture operating system: personas, opportunity tracking, source-backed artifacts, decision logs, and agent workflows that compound across ventures.

achievements.title: Parallel Human — my AI-native venture studio
achievements.blurb: My studio: one founder and a stack of AI agents building and running a portfolio of companies. The ventures here came out of it, each carried from blank page toward production with the same discipline: workflow research, information architecture, implementation, QA, and iteration.

achievements.title: AgXactly — founder, ~$1M raised, exit to Nighthawk Ag
achievements.blurb: Founded and led an agtech precision-data company as CEO and head of GTM. Triple-digit month-over-month growth in year one to $45K MRR, selling to the largest US leafy-greens growers (Taylor Farms, Church Brothers, Braga Fresh, Earthbound Farms). Acquired by Nighthawk Ag.

achievements.title: OrganicGrow Solutions — $400K+ revenue in 18 months
achievements.blurb: Built the company while selling it: soil-amendment products, lab testing, and organic certifications in parallel with enterprise grower deals in Canada.

achievements.title: Vesta.AI — first company, first failure, the lesson
achievements.blurb: Raised $50K from Jack Astor's corporate group on the strength of the pitch. The venture failed when the technical cofounder couldn't build what he claimed, which is why I became the technical builder myself.

achievements.title: Enterprise sales career — cold call to multimillion-dollar deals
achievements.blurb: Top sales associate across teams: multimillion-dollar packaging systems into pharma and logistics at Veritiv (a $10B distributor), millions in telecom and cloud contracts at CogecoPeer1, and a VP of Sales seat in cybersecurity leading red-team and code-audit engagements.

achievements.title: AIVA Network — CRM & automation backbone for a federal agtech ecosystem
achievements.blurb: Ecosystem Manager and systems architect for one of Canada's largest federally funded agtech ecosystems. Built startup intake, evaluation, routing, and operating workflows in Airtable.

migration.title: Re-platformed a live, revenue-bearing app with verified no data loss.
migration.body1: I rebuilt GroomBook, a live grooming-business platform with a paying customer, from a single-file static app onto a modern stack — Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Supabase (Postgres) on Vercel — then cut production over with no data loss, confirmed by identical row counts before and after.
migration.body2: The cutover ran from a written runbook as a reversible, gated process: backups, drift checks, an atomic migration, an eight-point verifier, RLS hardening, and a rollback path I never needed.

open_cards.title: End-to-end build partner
open_cards.subject: Build partner
open_cards.sub: SaaS, platforms, web apps, or the CRM and automation backbones underneath them. Architecture through to maintenance.
open_cards.body: Greenfield builds and inherited stacks: product teardown, data model review, code surface mapping, QA loops, rebuild-versus-renovate planning, and ongoing maintenance. The GroomBook re-platform above is the working example. Best fit: teams that need someone to carry a system from idea or legacy state to running software.

open_cards.title: Embedded AI-native consultant
open_cards.subject: AI-native consultant
open_cards.sub: Inside a product or engineering org that wants AI in the workflow without losing senior judgment.
open_cards.body: I run my own studio AI-native. AI supports specs, tickets, implementation, QA, and documentation, with human judgment controlling architecture, security, and acceptance. Best fit: teams that want the leverage of agents with discipline underneath — tight context, scoped tasks, review gates, browser QA.

open_cards.title: Senior product or technical lead
open_cards.subject: Senior product/technical lead
open_cards.sub: Head of Product, product/technical lead, or interim CTO. Brought in by the founder, the board, or an investor.
open_cards.body: A senior seat is open and the company knows it can't stay that way. The work underneath: understand the vision, map the workflow, build the system, ship the work, and help the team execute. Best fit: founders or investors who need embedded senior product and technical support.

profiles.quote: It was live customer data, so nobody gets to be casual. Rehearse the cutover, gate every step, keep the rollback ready. Boring is what good engineering looks like.
operate: I'm AI-native by default: output at the speed and quality of a small senior team, with my judgment owning architecture, security, and acceptance.
I'm disciplined with live systems: written runbooks, review gates, browser QA, and reversible cutovers when real data is on the line.
I inherit existing software comfortably: I audit the flow, code surface, data model, and QA gaps before I touch the architecture.
background: Russell Cole. Eight years in agtech, where founder work turned into hands-on product building. Founded AgXactly Crop Insights for crop scouting and supply-chain modelling; it raised roughly $1M and was acquired by Nighthawk Ag. Earlier ventures include Vesta.AI for restaurant smart-speaker ordering and OrganicGrow Solutions for soil amendments.

Through Parallel Human, I now build AI-native product systems end to end, including GroomBook, Ramara Hub, ChildCareOS, Agtech AR scouting, Signal Engine, F1 Fantasy Optimizer, Corbel, Life Archive, and KoyaOS. Also built the CRM and automation stack for the AIVA Network, one of Canada's largest federally funded agtech ecosystems. The pattern is consistent: understand the real workflow, map the product and data model, build the right system, ship it, test it, and keep improving it.

Stood up solo in a weekend through AI-assisted, agent-driven content and code workflows on a static GitHub Pages front end with a Supabase backend, with resident data tools like a budget viewer and project tracker in development.

work_cards.title: GroomBook — live production SaaS, re-platformed with zero downtime
work_cards.sub: 0 rows lost · 1,754-test CI gate · 137 clients, 737 appts live · voice AI assistant + full redesign shipped to production
work_cards.body: Rebuilt a revenue-bearing grooming platform onto Next.js and Supabase and cut the live business over with no data loss, via a reversible, gated runbook. Then shipped an in-app AI assistant the owner runs by voice and text, where every booking, payment, or message is confirmed before it saves, and deployed a full visual redesign across every screen, all to her live production app, behind the same gated pipeline. Directed an AI agent dev team (Claude + Codex) under human-gated releases, with a CI quality gate, cross-tenant isolation tests, row-level-security hardening, and error monitoring.

work_cards.title: Auction Advisor — real-time auction-intelligence platform
work_cards.sub: 22,000+ items · high-confidence comps on more than half · in daily use
work_cards.body: Conceived and architected a platform that grounds a live auction catalog of more than 22,000 items against retail prices to score deal quality, with real-time finals and full bid-trail capture. Built solo through AI-assisted engineering; diagnosed and recovered a production data-loss incident and re-established a durable system of record.

work_cards.title: ChildCareOS — AI-native operations SaaS for childcare
work_cards.sub: design partner engaged · multi-module platform in active build
work_cards.body: Building an operations platform for licensed childcare centres: a funding console, attendance reconciliation, enrollment forecasting, and provincial compliance workflows. Scaffolded on Next.js and Supabase with a design partner engaged, directed end to end through an AI agent dev team under human-gated releases.

work_cards.title: Agtech AR scouting — heads-up pest management for greenhouses
work_cards.sub: design partner engaged · live backend · 53 passing tests
work_cards.body: Designing and building an augmented-reality platform for greenhouse integrated pest management: a perception layer that turns what an agronomist sees into pest and task alerts, plus an action dispatcher that routes the work. In active build with a design partner and a live backend.

work_cards.title: Signal Engine — video intelligence in one paste
work_cards.body: A tool that turns any video link into a clean transcript, a summary, and purpose-specific insight. Phase 0 MVP in active build with a passing test suite; freemium model planned.

work_cards.title: Corbel — AI-native RevOps consulting
work_cards.body: A services-first consulting practice that reviews and rebuilds revenue-operations systems in Airtable and Notion, in Fix, Review, and Operate tiers. Full go-to-market built and readied for market: positioning, offer, pricing model, and pipeline.

work_cards.title: KoyaOS — multi-venture operating system
work_cards.body: Information architecture and build of my own multi-venture operating system: personas, opportunity tracking, source-backed artifacts, decision logs, and agent workflows that compound across ventures.

work_cards.title: Parallel Human — my AI-native venture studio
work_cards.body: My studio: one founder and a stack of AI agents building and running a portfolio of companies. The ventures here came out of it, each carried from blank page toward production with the same discipline: workflow research, information architecture, implementation, QA, and iteration.

work_cards.title: AgXactly — founder, ~$1M raised, exit to Nighthawk Ag
work_cards.body: Founded and led an agtech precision-data company as CEO and head of GTM. Triple-digit month-over-month growth in year one to $45K MRR, selling to the largest US leafy-greens growers (Taylor Farms, Church Brothers, Braga Fresh, Earthbound Farms). Acquired by Nighthawk Ag.

work_cards.title: OrganicGrow Solutions — $400K+ revenue in 18 months
work_cards.body: Built the company while selling it: soil-amendment products, lab testing, and organic certifications in parallel with enterprise grower deals in Canada.

work_cards.title: Vesta.AI — first company, first failure, the lesson
work_cards.body: Raised $50K from Jack Astor's corporate group on the strength of the pitch. The venture failed when the technical cofounder couldn't build what he claimed, which is why I became the technical builder myself.
